title: A Tomb of Twins
globalRules: East and west paths may be explored in either order.
Player death inside the tomb can transition that PC into a playable ghost.
Room 1 bell alters Room 7 swampkin preparedness.
Soul vial custody and anti-magic protection persist after the dungeon ends.
Removing unprotected vials awakens corresponding lich-state consequences.
Suggested choices never prohibit free-text alternatives.

scenes.title: Rumours in Dreklow
requiredFacts: The tomb overshadows Dreklow and several people want what is inside.
hiddenFacts: Galduz wants the twins released; Marzena wants safe containment; Bogumila wants to sell the vials.

choices.label: Buy drinks and collect rumours first
Ignore the offers and investigate the tomb for yourself

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Allow bargaining and interviewing. Do not label any employer as trustworthy/correct in UI.

scenes.title: The Black Dome
requiredFacts: The tomb is a polished black dome with unlocked silver doors.

choices.label: Inspect the exterior for another entrance

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: False rumours such as a roof door do not become real because players search for them.

scenes.title: Entrance and Alarm
requiredFacts: Poor tripwire/cowbell crosses the entrance; glyph sequence is hidden above inner doorway.
hiddenFacts: Bell alerts swampkins in Room 7; glyphs solve Rooms 5/8.

choices.label: Disarm or step over the tripwire
Study the marks above the doorway
Ignore the tripwire and push through

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Trap is telegraphed and may be bypassed creatively. If bell rings, persist alert state.

scenes.title: Painted Twins
requiredFacts: No obvious route deeper; carvings depict mirrored twin sequences.
hiddenFacts: Gold sconces open east/west secret doors; carvings encode disguise/amulet pattern.

choices.label: Inspect the eastern wall and sconce
Inspect the western wall and sconce
Test the walls and echoes for hidden doors

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Either secret route can be discovered first. Do not require both before entering one.

scenes.title: Drezis's Treasury
requiredFacts: Three trapped chests and icy basin occupy the room.
hiddenFacts: Body heat triggers trap; basin water disables it and aids ghost combat.

choices.label: Inspect the chest handles/trap before touching
Use the icy basin water on the chests
Open the treasuries and collect Drezis's belongings
Prepare a weapon with the basin water

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Respect trap telegraphing and alternative cold-object bypass.

scenes.title: Faceless Banquet
requiredFacts: Seven faceless guardians sit at table; central figure wears moon amulet.
hiddenFacts: Full Drezis outfit avoids attack; central amulet/figure controls group state.

choices.label: Try to remove the moon amulet from the central figure
Focus on the necklace-bearing central figure

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Guardians do not pursue outside room; disguise and amulet solutions remain available.

scenes.title: Eastern Glyph Floor
requiredFacts: Nine glowing glyph tiles cover floor.
hiddenFacts: Room 1 sequence is safe; wrong step lowers ceiling.

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Wrong sequence starts timed crushing ceiling; plausible bypasses may work under selected rules.

scenes.title: Woxis's Floating Treasury
requiredFacts: Treasury trap is already active; entrants begin floating; trapped swampkin grunt is at ceiling.
hiddenFacts: Basin water disables trap; grunt trades information for help.

choices.label: Reach/use the icy basin to stop the trap
Open the chests and collect Woxis's belongings
Prepare a weapon with basin water

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Low gravity changes movement; do not ignore the current trap state.

scenes.title: The Swampkins' Ruined Banquet
requiredFacts: Swampkins destroyed the original guardian encounter and breached the tomb from Room 12.
hiddenFacts: Pristina can negotiate; ambush preparation depends on bell.

choices.label: Search the looted banquet remains for the western amulet trail
Continue toward the western glyph room
Follow the breach into the swampkin cave

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: If bellRung, begin from ambush-prepared posture, but surrender/parley remains possible.

scenes.title: The Swampkin Cave
requiredFacts: Juris, Cestina and swampkin force occupy cave and possess loot from Room 7.
hiddenFacts: Leadership goals conflict; Juris can betray; Pristina favours cooperation; Cestina prefers violence/exit.

choices.label: Work through Pristina instead of Juris

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Sun amulet custody depends on actual source loot/search/negotiation. Do not auto-award it solely for entering Room 12.

scenes.title: Lost in the Tunnels
requiredFacts: The rough tunnels can loop, dead-end, emerge in marsh or lead to more swampkins.
hiddenFacts: Endless red string is a strong source navigation solution.

choices.label: Use endless red string to mark a return route
Try to reach the marsh outside Dreklow

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Use source maze outcomes; navigation magic/tools can change odds.

scenes.title: Western Glyph Floor
requiredFacts: Mirrored glyph-floor challenge; a crushed swampkin shows danger.
hiddenFacts: Same Room 1 glyph sequence solves it.

choices.label: Study what happened to the crushed swampkin

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Same trap logic as Room 5; preserve reset behavior.

scenes.title: Respite
requiredFacts: Paths reunite; healing basin and removable light orb are available.
hiddenFacts: Purple liquid is an anti-magic ritual ingredient and ghost-weapon aid.

choices.label: Take some purple liquid with you
Remove the glowing orb for portable light
Go back and explore the other branch

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Track basin daily-use state and removed-liquid expiration.

scenes.title: The Bronze Doors
requiredFacts: Final doors have moon/sun recesses and a dangerous magical-fire response to forcing.

choices.label: Place the moon and sun amulets in the doors
Try another physical or magical bypass

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Correct amulets are safe source solution; other approaches face source trap/mechanics but are not automatically impossible.

scenes.title: The Soul Vials
requiredFacts: Twin sarcophagi and anti-magic-contained soul vials are present.
hiddenFacts: Hidden ritual scroll explains safe containment/movement.

choices.label: Search the pedestal and chamber before touching the vials
Take the soul vials without changing the field
Empty one or both soul vials
Leave the vials contained and withdraw

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Any action affecting vial containment must update each twin independently.

scenes.title: The Twins Rise
requiredFacts: Unprotected soul-vial removal permits lich awakening; twins immediately quarrel.
hiddenFacts: They will eventually call a truce and pursue conquest if left unresolved.

choices.label: Exploit what their journals reveal about mutual betrayal
Target or empty the soul vials
Try to bargain with one twin against the other

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Twins are powerful but distracted by mutual hatred. Allow exploitation and independent vial destruction.

scenes.title: Brother Against Brother
requiredFacts: Drezis and Woxis are willing to fight each other temporarily.
hiddenFacts: If both survive long enough they call a truce.

choices.label: Use the distraction to destroy both soul vials

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Track each lich/vial separately. A surviving twin remains dangerous.

scenes.title: Who Gets the Vials?
requiredFacts: Vial custody and protection determine aftermath.
hiddenFacts: Galduz releases them; Bogumila eventually loses safe containment; Marzena secures Academy containment.

choices.label: Bring the vials to Galduz's promised immortality ritual
Keep the vials and maintain containment yourself

freeTextPolicy.adjudicationRule: Other custody plans are valid but must establish credible long-term anti-magic containment or face awakening risk.

endings.title: Leave the Dead Where They Are
endings.summary: The vials remain under tomb containment and the Priesthood can continue its monthly ritual. Treasure/information obtained elsewhere remains with the party.

endings.title: Safe in the Academy
endings.summary: Marzena delivers protected vials to the Arcane Academy, which recognises their danger and maintains anti-magic containment.

endings.title: Sold to the Highest Bidder
endings.summary: Bogumila sells the vials. Without permanent ritual knowledge, the temporary protection eventually expires and the twins rise later.

endings.title: The Corrupt Priest's Plan
endings.summary: Galduz deliberately removes protection, releases the twins and kills himself. The lich threat becomes immediate.

endings.title: Custodians of Two Souls
endings.summary: The party keeps the vials and inherits the obligation to renew anti-magic containment monthly or develop an equivalent permanent solution.

endings.title: No Liches Left to Rise
endings.summary: Both soul vials are emptied/destroyed and both twins are permanently ended.

endings.title: The Tower Rises Again
endings.summary: Escaped twins destroy Dreklow's priestly containment order, enslave the village, rebuild their tower and begin raising a wider undead army.
